source.compiler: Alex Sawczuk's 'Sawczuk Update' (7th version, transfers to 26 October 2003, with German, Croatian, US and other data he credits to contributors), as the Official Championship Manager Magazine's issue 5 cover CD (Future Publishing, November 2003) carries it: its Data tables read by HTTP range from archive.org cmmag-05 (CMMag05.iso); club.dat and staff.dat are the files src/data/cm0102Releases.js pins for it
source.provenance: A fan's update of SI's CM 01/02 3.9.68 database (November 2002). For players kept under the same staff id and name, 98.6% of current abilities are still SI's 3.9.68 values (103,459 rated in both), so most ratings are a season old; the rest were changed by hand, above all in the Premier League, where 57% of players were re-rated, 8.2 points higher on average on the 1-200 scale, against 10-14% and +1.6 to +1.9 in Serie A, La Liga and the Bundesliga and 0.9% outside the seven leagues. English clubs so take 15 places of the Elite 32, where 3.9.68 gives them 7. 375 rated players are new. The squads are of October 2003: Beckham at Real Madrid, Ronaldinho at Barcelona, Cristiano Ronaldo at Manchester United, Duff, Crespo, Makelele and Verón at Chelsea. Its Eredivisie lists Excelsior (eight rated players) instead of FC Volendam, so it fields 17 clubs; its La Liga lists Real Oviedo, relegated in 2001, and puts Málaga in the second division; its Ligue 1 keeps CM 01/02's 18 clubs, so Ajaccio and Montpellier, in 2003/04's 20-club Ligue 1, play in its second division. Players who retired before the season keep their records with a current ability of 1 (Schmeichel, Bierhoff, Blanc); none of them is among the players written.
